messages:
Nina: hi all, newbie question. I set up a tiny CI job that runs a few quick streaming calls using an ephemeral token. CI started spamming the sandbox and now my personal tests are getting 429s. Did I break anything?
Carlos: welcome Nina! sandbox is a shared pool. CI jobs that open many parallel streams can push the shared quota and cause others to see 429s. not a hard break, just hitting rate limits.
Nina: ah got it. how do i check what quota the CI hit? the CI logs just show 429s.
DevEx: check the 429 response headers in the failing requests. we include remaining, reset, and a reason string. example: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 1861112260
x-rw-retry-after: 3.0
{ "error":"rate_limited", "reason":"requests_per_min" }
```
Carlos: also check the CI's token usage pattern. ephemeral tokens inherit the org/project quota. if the CI starts many runners in parallel it counts toward the same bucket.
Nina: is there a quick mitigation while we fix the CI?
Maya: yes: 1) pause the CI job or reduce parallelism; 2) switch CI to use a dedicated demo sandbox key (devex can issue one) so it doesn't affect personal flows; 3) add basic client-side throttling/backoff on 429s.
DevEx: to get a dedicated sandbox key or a short boost, ping #devex with the job name, token ID, and time window. we typically provision ephemeral demo keys or temporary quota bumps for onboarding. InfraBot: ticket DX-5517 created for Nina (sandbox demo key requested).
Nina: thanks. quick follow-up: do embedding and chat calls share the same quota? my CI mixes both.
Carlos: many orgs share tokens/min across routes, but some tiers have separate embedding quotas. look for x-rw-embed-* headers in responses to confirm. otherwise assume shared.
Maya: design tip: in CI use small prompt sizes, cap max_tokens, and avoid launching many simultaneous streaming sessions. if you need heavy parallel load tests, coordinate with eng-infra to run them in a separate capacity/project.
Nina: any sample backoff strategy you recommend?
DevEx: simple exponential backoff + jitter works well. e.g. base=200ms, max=5s, cap attempts=5. for streaming, backoff on connection-level 429s and retry in a staggered way.
Nina: perfect. i'll pause the CI, request a demo key from devex, and add backoff. thanks everyone! :)
